name: WeightedScorecard
tagline: The Weighted Scorecard turns a single multi-line text column into a complete evaluation form.
description: The Weighted Scorecard turns a single multi-line text column into a complete evaluation form. Evaluators score each criterion on a simple scale, and the control works out the weighted total, shows it against the pass mark, and flags anything that needs attention: missing comments, unscored items and knock-out criteria that fail the whole evaluation on their own.
features: Weighted criteria scored on a configurable scale with N/A
Comments required for low scores, knock-out criteria
Optionally writes the total to a number column
